title: Playable Spaces: Habitt first home ad v4

lines.text: You're furnishing your first home, and every piece costs real money.
Every sofa looks perfect in the photo, but once it's delivered, you live with it.
Move it across the room, try it in green, and see how it looks at night.
When it finally feels like home, tap the real price and buy it from Habitt.
Comment PLAY and I'll send you the link.
